evidence_spans: Maximum EQE: 20% for the planar reference and 55.8% with the microlens-array film and the auxiliary Ag reflector .

The green OLED has the structure ITO (150 nm)/HA TCN (5 nm)/TAPC (55 nm)/HATCN (5 nm)/TAPC (55 nm)/HA TCN (5 nm)/TAPC (55 nm)/TCTA (10 nm)/TCTA:B3PyMPM:Ir(ppy)2acac (25 nm, 4 wt%, co-evaporation)/B3PyMPM (50 nm)/B3PyMPM:Cs₂CO₃ (5 nm, 20 wt%)/Ag (100 nm)
A microlens-array film (MAF02, Lumtec) was used as the outcoupling structure, and index-matching oil (Immersion oil type-F, Olympus) removed the air gap to the glass substrate.

A 3-µm Parylene-C coating on top served both as an additional thin-film encapsulation and as the insulating layer that electrically separates the upper MoO x/Ag reflector (5/100 nm) from the device below.

The maximum EQE increased 2.8-fold, from 20% for the planar reference to 55.8%, in agreement with the 55.9% predicted by our simulation; multiple devices fabricated in the same batch showed nearly identical characteristics (Supplementary Fig. 7).
CLM-DEV-0054.statement: Adding an auxiliary Ag reflector and microlens-array film to the green phosphorescent OLED increased its maximum external quantum efficiency from 20% for the planar reference to 55.8%.

evidence_spans: Maximum EQE: planar reference device 23% , microlens-array substrate without auxiliary reflector 51%, with Al auxiliary reflector 61% and with the DBR auxiliary reflector 77%.
On top of it, HATCN (5 nm)/TAPC (95 nm)/HATCN (5 nm)/TAPC (95 nm)/TCTA (10 nm)/TCTA:B3PyMPM:Ir(dmppy-ph)2tmd (25 nm, 4 wt%, co-evaporation)/B3PyMPM (55 nm)/Liq (1 nm)/Al (100 nm) were deposited
a DBR of 4.5 alternating ZnS (70 nm)/LiF (115 nm)  pairs was deposited on the rear of the finished device.

Depositing a DBR consisting of 4.5 ZnS/LiF pairs on top of a device with the same stack instead raised the EQE to 77%,  which corresponds to 𝜂sta = 87.5% using the  𝜂sub of 88%  calculated for this device.
CLM-DEV-0055.statement: An orange phosphorescent OLED on a high-index microlens substrate reached a maximum external quantum efficiency of 77% when equipped with a ZnS/LiF DBR auxiliary reflector.

evidence_spans: Maximum EQE: planar reference device 23% , microlens-array substrate without auxiliary reflector 51%, with Al auxiliary reflector 61% and with the DBR auxiliary reflector 77%.
On top of it, HATCN (5 nm)/TAPC (95 nm)/HATCN (5 nm)/TAPC (95 nm)/TCTA (10 nm)/TCTA:B3PyMPM:Ir(dmppy-ph)2tmd (25 nm, 4 wt%, co-evaporation)/B3PyMPM (55 nm)/Liq (1 nm)/Al (100 nm) were deposited
With an Al  mirror placed behind the device as auxiliary reflector, the EQE rose to 61%, consistent with the limit of around 60% calculated for an Al reflector (Fig. 2f).
CLM-DEV-0056.statement: An orange phosphorescent OLED on a high-index microlens substrate reached a maximum external quantum efficiency of 61% with an Al auxiliary reflector.

extra_quotes: The green OLED has the structure ITO (150 nm)/HA TCN (5 nm)/TAPC (55 nm)/HATCN (5 nm)/TAPC (55 nm)/HA TCN (5 nm)/TAPC (55 nm)/TCTA (10 nm)/TCTA:B3PyMPM:Ir(ppy)2acac (25 nm, 4 wt%, co-evaporation)/B3PyMPM (50 nm)/B3PyMPM:Cs₂CO₃ (5 nm, 20 wt%)/Ag (100 nm) and was encapsulated with a thin-film nanolaminate of alternating Al₂O₃ and ZrO₂ deposited by atomic layer deposition.
The orange OLED was fabricated on a high -index substrate patterned with a microlens array (HNPS01, 𝑛 = 1.77, Lumtec), on which 50 nm of IZO deposited by RF sputtering (123 W) served as the anode.

The EQE was obtained from the angle-resolved measurements by the method described previously45,46, which accounts for any non-Lambertian emission of the device and thus avoids over- or underestimation of the EQE.
The auxiliary reflectors used here require space outside the active area.
